spec.rawSql:
SELECT w.window_start, w.window_end, w.data_end,
  (SELECT name FROM org_units WHERE id = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) AS place
FROM report_window('${reporting_month}'::date) w
WHERE '$isAllowed' = '1'

SELECT t.*,
  (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'titration' AND key = 'flag_below_pct') AS flag_below_pct, (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'titration' AND key = 'min_visits') AS min_visits
FROM report_titration('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) t
WHERE t.is_selected AND '$isAllowed' = '1'

SELECT t.org_unit_id, t.org_unit_name, t.level, t.is_selected, t.too_few, t.flag, t.uncontrolled_visits_n, t.stepped_up_n, t.titration_pct,
  (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'titration' AND key = 'flag_below_pct') AS flag_below_pct, (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'titration' AND key = 'min_visits') AS min_visits
FROM report_titration('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) t
WHERE '$isAllowed' = '1'

spec.description: Each bar is the share of a facility's high-BP visits followed by a stronger prescription. Bars left of the dashed 40% line are flagged.
spec.title: Share of high-BP visits stepped up, by facility

spec.rawSql:
SELECT t.org_unit_id, t.org_unit_name, t.uncontrolled_visits_n, t.stepped_up_n, t.titration_pct, t.looks_fine_check, fl.patients_n,
  (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'titration' AND key = 'flag_below_pct') AS flag_below_pct, (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'titration' AND key = 'min_visits') AS min_visits
FROM report_titration('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) t
JOIN report_flags('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) fl ON fl.org_unit_id = t.org_unit_id AND fl.report = 'titration'
WHERE t.flag AND '$isAllowed' = '1'

WITH fl AS (
  SELECT org_unit_id, json_agg(json_build_object('report', report, 'flag_reason', flag_reason, 'patients_n', patients_n)
           ORDER BY report)::text AS flags_json
  FROM report_flags('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) GROUP BY org_unit_id
)
SELECT t.*,
  (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'titration' AND key = 'flag_below_pct') AS flag_below_pct, (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'titration' AND key = 'min_visits') AS min_visits,
  fl.flags_json
FROM report_titration('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) t
LEFT JOIN fl ON fl.org_unit_id = t.org_unit_id
WHERE '$isAllowed' = '1'

options.content: How this is worked out. Looks at visits with BP 140/90 or above in the last 90 days. A visit counts as stepped up if it, or the next within 30 days, has a stronger prescription. Stronger means more medicines or a higher dose than the visit before. Visits in the last 30 days of data are left out, as are visits with no earlier prescription.
